// Test-owned fixture of tests/admin_audit_attribution_test.cjs (not product code). One module per case, put next to the
// baseline fixture of tests/fixtures/admin_audit_completeness as api/src/syn-fixture/case-<name>.ts; with it the gate must
// fail on exactly the class its header names, on exactly the candidates its lines mark (`// expect:`, as there).
//   // ==== case: <name> | verdict: <class> [entries] [| table: +row <action> | table: +wildcard <stem>] ====
// The counterexamples Astra S7-U3a-AUDIT-SPEC-C-R-001-F03 enumerates, by finding and module variant (the case name starts
// with the finding: e-f01-*, e-f02-*, e-f03-*, f-f01-*, f-f02-*, c-raw-cast-*), each on its own; the E-F03 and F-F01
// modules come twice, as Astra wrote them (a readonly field, now outside W2 as a whole) and with a private helper (inside
// the list: the helper's calls may not be what the object runs). fix6's other E-F03 cases (a readonly field or an enum
// whose object escapes: behind an alias, written through an untyped alias, an instance or the class handed on, the
// prototype, a called member the check does not read) stay as they were, now refused because W2 reads no property; each
// of those escapes comes again with a private helper. Then `moved-*`: every construct fix6 took as a supported
// notation that the closed list W1-W6 leaves out, refused here as unresolved (their lines in
// tests/fixtures/admin_audit_completeness/equivalent.ts and in members.ts before fix7; tests/fixtures/admin-audit-checker/
// reclassified.json names each). A fragment handed on is also its own candidate where it is handed on (W4 over every
// fragment).

// ==== case: e-f01-a-helper-called-by-a-constant-key-with-a-request-value | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const GO = 'go';
export class SynHelper {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved `body.kind` is a property the program does not fix
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed');
    await this[GO](tx, body.kind);
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-helper-object-read-by-an-unfixed-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynHelper {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved which is read by a key the program does not fix
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed'); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.go`, which this check does not follow
    await (this as any)[body.method](body.db, body.kind); // expect: proven_non_audit no client value reaches
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-with-fragment-helper-called-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const LINK = 'linked';
export class SynPaths {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved `body.where` is not a Prisma.sql text
  }
  async fixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`); }
  async unfixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, body: any) { await this[LINK](tx, actor, body.where); }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-readonly-field-written-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====

  }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-helper-replaced-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
declare function opaque(...values: unknown[]): unknown;
const KEY = 'audit';
export class SynReplaced {
  private audit(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved (the method is replaced)

  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) { await this.audit(tx, 'syn.allowed'); } // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.audit`, which this check does not follow
}

// ==== case: e-f01-an-enum-member-written-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
enum Kind { Allowed = 'syn.allowed' }
const KEY = 'Allow' + 'ed';

  (Kind as any)[KEY] = body.kind; // expect: proven_non_audit no client value reaches
  await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: Kind.Allowed } }); // expect: unresolved `Kind.Allowed` is a property the program does not fix
}

// ==== case: e-f01-an-unknown-constant-key-call-of-a-with-helper | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynPaths {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved which is read by a key the program does not fix
  }
  async fixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) {
    await this.linked(tx, // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.linked`, which this check does not follow
      actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`); // expect: unresolved (Sql) is handed to `this.linked`
  }
  async unknown(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await (this as any)[body.name]( // expect: proven_non_audit no client value reaches
      tx, body.actor, body.where); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `(this as any)[body.name]`, which this check does not follow
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-written-through-a-member | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string, body: any) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  (selector as any).strings[0] = body.sql; // expect: unresolved `selector` (Sql) is asserted to `any`
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is written at
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-written-by-a-local-helper | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
function widen(fragment: Prisma.Sql, sql: string) { (fragment as any).strings[0] = sql; } // expect: unresolved `fragment` (Sql) is asserted to `any`
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string, body: any) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  widen(selector, body.sql);
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is written at
}

// ==== case: c-raw-cast-in-fixed-non-audit-sql | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string, fragment: Prisma.Sql) {
  const value = fragment as unknown as string; // expect: unresolved `fragment` (Sql) is asserted to `unknown`
  return tx.$executeRaw`UPDATE "StudyState" SET ward = ${value} WHERE uid = ${uid}`; // expect: unresolved `value` is not shown to be a value: `fragment` (Sql) is an SQL fragment
}

// ==== case: c-raw-cast-through-a-function-result | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
function launder(fragment: Prisma.Sql): string { return fragment as any; } // expect: unresolved `fragment` (Sql) is asserted to `any`
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, fragment: Prisma.Sql) {
  return tx.$executeRaw`INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action, target) VALUES ('syn.allowed', ${launder(fragment)})`; // expect: unresolved so its type is no evidence
}

// ==== case: c-raw-cast-through-a-parameter-typed-any | verdict: unresolved ====

function launder(value: any): string { return value; }
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, fragment: Prisma.Sql) {
  // expect: unresolved so its type is no evidence
  return tx.$executeRaw`UPDATE "StudyState" SET ward = ${launder(
    fragment)}`; // expect: unresolved `fragment` (Sql) is handed to `launder`
}

}

    await this.go(tx, this.field);

  }
}

// ==== case: u0b-f01-a-helper-called-through-an-assertion-to-any | verdict: unresolved ====
// Astra AUDIT-CHECKER-U0B review F01: what is read or called through an assertion is typed at the asserted type, so the
// call is not one the check reads; the object no longer keeps to the program (W4), before W3-C and since.
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynAsserted {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved which is read through the assertion `this as any`
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed'); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.go`, which this check does not follow
    await (this as any).go(tx, body.kind); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `(this as any).go`, which this check does not follow
  }
}

// ==== case: u0b-f01-a-helper-called-through-a-structural-assertion | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
type SynGo = { go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string): unknown };
export class SynAsserted {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved which is read through the assertion `this as unknown as SynGo`
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed'); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.go`, which this check does not follow
    await (this as unknown as SynGo).go(tx, body.kind); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `(this as unknown as SynGo).go`, which this check does not follow
  }
}

// ==== case: u0b-r3-p01-a-private-helper-called-through-this-as-any | verdict: unresolved ====
// Astra AUDIT-CHECKER-U0B consult 2, P01 (her probe source verbatim but for the marks): the base W3 helper read through
// an erased receiver is the same projection obligation (rule B′ I2) as an owned slot's.
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynPrivate {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved which is read through the assertion `this as any`
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed'); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.go`, which this check does not follow
    await (this as any).go(tx, body.kind); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `(this as any).go`, which this check does not follow
  }
}

// ==== case: u0b-r3-p02-a-private-helper-called-by-a-widened-key | verdict: unresolved ====
// P02: the key W1 fixes, read as any (`'go' as any`): the call is no longer one of the helper's (W4 projection: result).
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynPrivate {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved (W4 projection: result)
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed'); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this.go`, which this check does not follow
    await this["go" as any](tx, body.kind); // expect: unresolved a client value handed to `this["go" as any]`, which this check does not follow
  }
}
